doc.caveat: This document names a TAXON and carries no reference parameter set, because this engine holds measured parameters only for the organisms in its bundle. Every parameter is therefore null, and every check that needs one returns cannot-evaluate. The taxon IS used: law scope is decided from it, so a law calibrated on another clade is reported out of scope rather than applied. Nothing here is a measurement of this organism, and no number has been substituted for one.

result.clade_note: The taxon is placed, so every law that scopes to one of these clades will be judged for this organism, and a law scoped elsewhere is reported out of scope with its clade named.
